reviews.title: Worst Instructions Ever
reviews.comment: Worst, and I do mean the WORST instruction manual I have ever received. Single images per assembly step. No real descriptive language either. None better online either. Unclear how to assemble the CPU adapter arms in particular. Top or bottom of the base of the cooler? Made the wrong choice and the plate did not contact the CPU. Fixed that, but you have to partially disassemble the cooler cover to put them on. That's not clear in the instructions either. I'm no noob. I've assembled a number of PC's including on with a Peltier cooler. All I can say about this is that it keeps the CPU reasonably cool. (AMD 9950x).
reviews.author: H2Cobra

reviews.title: Cool and quiet.
reviews.comment: Took a while to ship but otherwise arrived in great condition and works perfectly paired with a 9600X. Not sure what the actual cooling capacity is as I’ve not tried it with higher wattage CPUs or overclocking. Used this in an all ASUS TUF gaming build with ARGB lighting. It’s super quiet and colors match the case fans. Cooling hoses are flexible and LEDs are perfect brightness. Fits easily in my mid tower case.
reviews.author: Aaron
